summaryDeep: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort work smoothly with your imagination, hope, and idealism. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: The difficulty is that what feels healing can slowly become necessary. Because emotional support flows so naturally, neither person may notice when the relationship starts carrying more weight than it should. The Moon person may begin looking to the Neptune person for reassurance they need to learn to give themselves. The Neptune person may absorb the Moon person's emotions so completely that they lose track of where their own begin. This rarely happens overnight. It is usually the result of many small moments of comfort accumulating over time.
advice: The gift of this aspect is emotional trust. The lesson is remembering that closeness works best when it connects two whole people, not when it becomes the place where either person disappears.
summaryShort: Their moods, needs, and habits of comfort work smoothly with your imagination, hope, and idealism.
